description: LinuxDroid native GUI dependency manifest. Source policy: repositories under the InfidelRahul/ GitHub org (LinuxDroid mirrors) track their `main` branch and record the exact resolved commit per build; all other (official upstream) dependencies use the latest stable release and record its exact commit. Everything is cross-built for Android arm64-v8a / API 36+.

platform.archComment: Only arm64-v8a / API 36+ is supported. No x86, x86_64, or ARM32 targets are built or packaged. Every produced native library must be an AArch64 ELF.

toolchain.meson: >= 0.63.0 (provided by CI; the mirror-main weston bundles its own meson files)
toolchain.buildToolComment: libweston and its dependencies are built with Meson (the upstream, authoritative build system for Weston/libweston); the Android Gradle/CMake externalNativeBuild path cannot consume the upstream Meson tree, so an isolated Meson cross-build is used. See native/weston/README.md.

weston.comments: Tracks the InfidelRahul/weston development mirror `main` branch (a LinuxDroid fork, not an upstream stable release). The exact resolved HEAD commit is recorded in src/.weston_commit and verified by fetch-weston.sh / verify-weston.sh. On the current `main` HEAD (9669073f) this declares Weston version 16.0.90 with libweston_major=17 (so Meson produces libweston-17 and installs headers under include/libweston-17/). The mirror main requires wayland-server/client >= 1.24.0, wayland-protocols >= 1.46, pixman-1 >= 0.25.2, xkbcommon >= 0.5.0, libdrm >= 2.4.108, libdisplay-info >= 0.2.0 < 0.5.0; shared/meson.build declares lib_cairo_shared (cairo + libpng) and the headless-backend links it, so cairo+libpng+zlib are build-required.

wayland.comments: Tracks the InfidelRahul/wayland development mirror `main` branch. On the current `main` HEAD (381af21c) this declares Wayland version 1.26.90 (dev). Provides wayland-server, wayland-client, wayland-scanner and wayland-cursor, and satisfies the mirror-main weston's >= 1.24.0 requirement.

wayland-protocols.comments: Tracks the InfidelRahul/wayland-protocols development mirror `main` branch. On the current `main` HEAD (afb614d5) this is the 1.x series; it satisfies the mirror-main weston's >= 1.46 requirement. All protocols the mirror-main weston generates must be present in the checked-out wayland-protocols.

pixman.comments: Tracks the InfidelRahul/pixman development mirror `main` branch (meson-buildable). Built for AArch64 with NEON paths; ARGB8888/RGBA8888/premultiplied-alpha/compositing/scaling/damage operations are provided by the library. Pixman is a dependency, NOT the LinuxDroid renderer (the renderer is a separate layer).

libxkbcommon.comments: Official upstream, latest stable libxkbcommon (not an InfidelRahul mirror). Built core + XKB keymap/state handling with X11 disabled (Wayland-only architecture; no libxkbcommon-x11, no xcb-xkb).

xkeyboard-config.comments: Official upstream, latest stable xkeyboard-config (2.48, released 2026-06-21). Pure keyboard-layout DATA, not a compiled library: it provides the XKB keymap database libxkbcommon loads at runtime from the Linux userspace (standard Linux XKB data path, <prefix>/share/X11/xkb). Installed into the Linux rootfs during bootstrap; it is NOT an Android runtime library and X11 is not a runtime requirement.

libffi.comments: Latest stable; required to cross-build libwayland.

libdrm.comments: Latest stable; mirror-main weston requires libdrm >= 2.4.108 at configure time; not linked into libweston-<major>.so.

libinput.comments: Latest stable; mirror-main weston configure-time dependency; built with udev/libseat disabled (Android target), not linked into libweston.

libevdev.comments: Latest stable; mirror-main weston configure-time dependency.

libdisplay-info.comments: Latest stable; mirror-main weston requires libdisplay-info >= 0.2.0 < 0.5.0 at configure time.

zlib.comments: Latest stable; required to cross-build libpng (and thus cairo).

libpng.comments: Latest stable; required by cairo for the image-surface backend (Weston's lib_cairo_shared).

cairo.comments: Latest stable. Mirror-main weston declares lib_cairo_shared (dependency('cairo') + dependency('libpng')) and the headless-backend links it, so cairo+libpng+zlib are required to configure and link weston even though they are NOT linked into libweston-<major>.so and are NOT part of the LinuxDroid renderer (Pixman -> GLES/EGL -> Vulkan). Built as a minimal image-only cairo (freetype/fontconfig/glib/x11/wayland/xcb disabled).

libweston.rendererComment: The renderer strategy is Pixman (bring-up) then GLES/EGL (production) then Vulkan (future/optional). libweston is the compositor core; the LinuxDroid renderer is a separate layer.

versionVerification.note: For InfidelRahul mirror dependencies the resolved `main` HEAD commit is the per-build reproducibility anchor (recorded + verified; a fixed SHA is intentionally NOT pinned). For official upstream dependencies the stable release + exact commit are recorded. Verification asserts the checked-out source (git HEAD) matches the recorded commit.
versionVerification.resolvedCommitRecord: native/weston/src/.weston_commit (weston); other tracked InfidelRahul deps record HEAD in native/weston/deps/src/<name>/.git
